work.title: The First Part of Henry the Sixth
work.author: William Shakespeare

scene.label: Act 4, Scene 4
scene.title: SCENE IV. Other plains in Gascony.

content.text: Enter Somerset with his army; a Captain of Talbot's with him.

lines.text: It is too late; I cannot send them now.
lines.plainText: It is too late I cannot send them now

lines.text: This expedition was by York and Talbot
lines.plainText: This expedition was by York and Talbot

lines.text: Too rashly plotted. All our general force
lines.plainText: Too rashly plotted All our general force

lines.text: Might with a sally of the very town
lines.plainText: Might with a sally of the very town

lines.text: Be buckled with. The over-daring Talbot
lines.plainText: Be buckled with The overdaring Talbot

lines.text: Hath sullied all his gloss of former honour
lines.plainText: Hath sullied all his gloss of former honour

lines.text: By this unheedful, desperate, wild adventure.
lines.plainText: By this unheedful desperate wild adventure

lines.text: York set him on to fight and die in shame
lines.plainText: York set him on to fight and die in shame

lines.text: That, Talbot dead, great York might bear the name.
lines.plainText: That Talbot dead great York might bear the name

lines.text: Here is Sir William Lucy, who with me
lines.plainText: Here is Sir William Lucy who with me

lines.text: Set from our o'er-match'd forces forth for aid.
lines.plainText: Set from our o'ermatch'd forces forth for aid

lines.text: How now, Sir William, whither were you sent?
lines.plainText: How now Sir William whither were you sent

lines.text: Whither, my lord? From bought and sold Lord Talbot,
lines.plainText: Whither my lord From bought and sold Lord Talbot

lines.text: Who, ring'd about with bold adversity,
lines.plainText: Who ring'd about with bold adversity

lines.text: Cries out for noble York and Somerset
lines.plainText: Cries out for noble York and Somerset

lines.text: To beat assailing Death from his weak legions;
lines.plainText: To beat assailing Death from his weak legions

lines.text: And whiles the honourable captain there
lines.plainText: And whiles the honourable captain there

lines.text: Drops bloody sweat from his war-wearied limbs,
lines.plainText: Drops bloody sweat from his warwearied limbs

lines.text: And, in advantage lingering, looks for rescue,
lines.plainText: And in advantage lingering looks for rescue

lines.text: You, his false hopes, the trust of England's honour,
lines.plainText: You his false hopes the trust of England's honour

lines.text: Keep off aloof with worthless emulation.
lines.plainText: Keep off aloof with worthless emulation

lines.text: Let not your private discord keep away
lines.plainText: Let not your private discord keep away

lines.text: The levied succours that should lend him aid,
lines.plainText: The levied succours that should lend him aid

lines.text: While he, renowned noble gentleman,
lines.plainText: While he renowned noble gentleman

lines.text: Yield up his life unto a world of odds.
lines.plainText: Yield up his life unto a world of odds

lines.text: Orleans the Bastard, Charles, Burgundy,
lines.plainText: Orleans the Bastard Charles Burgundy

lines.text: Alençon, Reignier, compass him about,
lines.plainText: Alenon Reignier compass him about

lines.text: And Talbot perisheth by your default.
lines.plainText: And Talbot perisheth by your default

lines.text: York set him on; York should have sent him aid.
lines.plainText: York set him on York should have sent him aid

lines.text: And York as fast upon your Grace exclaims,
lines.plainText: And York as fast upon your Grace exclaims

lines.text: Swearing that you withhold his levied host
lines.plainText: Swearing that you withhold his levied host

lines.text: Collected for this expedition.
lines.plainText: Collected for this expedition

lines.text: York lies; he might have sent and had the horse.
lines.plainText: York lies he might have sent and had the horse

lines.text: I owe him little duty, and less love,
lines.plainText: I owe him little duty and less love

lines.text: And take foul scorn to fawn on him by sending.
lines.plainText: And take foul scorn to fawn on him by sending

lines.text: The fraud of England, not the force of France,
lines.plainText: The fraud of England not the force of France

lines.text: Hath now entrapp'd the noble-minded Talbot.
lines.plainText: Hath now entrapp'd the nobleminded Talbot

lines.text: Never to England shall he bear his life,
lines.plainText: Never to England shall he bear his life

lines.text: But dies betray'd to fortune by your strife.
lines.plainText: But dies betray'd to fortune by your strife

lines.text: Come, go; I will dispatch the horsemen straight.
lines.plainText: Come go I will dispatch the horsemen straight

lines.text: Within six hours they will be at his aid.
lines.plainText: Within six hours they will be at his aid

lines.text: Too late comes rescue; he is ta'en or slain,
lines.plainText: Too late comes rescue he is ta'en or slain

lines.text: For fly he could not if he would have fled;
lines.plainText: For fly he could not if he would have fled

lines.text: And fly would Talbot never, though he might.
lines.plainText: And fly would Talbot never though he might

lines.text: If he be dead, brave Talbot, then adieu!
lines.plainText: If he be dead brave Talbot then adieu

lines.text: His fame lives in the world, his shame in you.
lines.plainText: His fame lives in the world his shame in you
